notes.title: Devlog 001
notes.content:
[h3]Sup guys!
It's the firs devlog here at Steam!
[/h3]
[previewyoutube=3Rdm1oF1sq4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]I've implemented weapon and vehicle parameter upgrades using money that can be earned not only by winning races but also by defeating opponents.
Boring but important details:
[list]
[*] The price and upgrade level of a parameter are displayed.
[*] Indication of insufficient funds or reaching the maximum upgrade level.
[*] Front spikes. They are not on the vehicle when the parameter is at 0 (visible only in the race, the vehicle doesn't change in the shop).
[*] Reward for each defeated enemy (plus, of course, the reward for 1st place).
[*] Text localization.
[/list]


[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2129870/discussions/]Share your thoughts in the game community! I will read everything and respond to everyone![/url]
[/h3]
